narrative: A city court in Delhi ordered an independent probe into the claim of a fake encounter. The petitioner, a man accused in an Arms Act case, alleged that Delhi Police officers illegally detained him, assaulted him, and then staged a fake encounter in which he was shot in the leg. The court found the allegations credible enough to warrant an independent investigation. The case was reported by Hindustan Times and highlighted the continuing problem of staged encounters in Delhi.
status_detail: Court ordered independent probe into alleged fake encounter. Delhi Police officers implicated. Investigation ongoing.

victim.name: Name withheld (petitioner in Arms Act case)
